content: I will modify `submitIngestConfig()` in `index.html` to save the active ingestion configuration into `localStorage` before initiating the task execution. This will allow the Telemetry status details to parse and present these inputs.

args.Description: "Persist custom_config in localStorage on submitIngestConfig so telemetry can read it."
args.Instruction: "Save ingest config to localStorage in submitIngestConfig."
